paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories—Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total—on the BIRD-dev dataset. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60, while the horizontal axis lists the problem difficulty categories. For each category, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL. In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21, and TA-SQL achieves 63.14. In Moderate, NatSQL scores 39.64, and TA-SQL scores 48.60. In Challenging, NatSQL scores 32.32, and TA-SQL scores 36.11. For the Total category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 51.35, and TA-SQL has 56.19. In all categories, TA-SQL demonstrates higher execution accuracy than NatSQL.
